deviations: The source assembles a pack and provides a Bash installer; this exercise ports its installer contract to Python as allowed by the lesson. The five defects are planted in the exercise, not asserted to exist together in the original source.

TSV manifests, explicit component-reference metadata and three-way hash statuses are deterministic exercise contracts extending the lesson versioning, file ownership and partial-package decisions. They are not claims about an external package format.
All schema changes require major in this exercise; migration_paths distinguishes migrating script changes. Exact next-version increments make the release exercise deterministic.
The itemize-style forward and rollback codes are private exercise text, not rsync protocol. Part 1 only protects version publication; Part 4 separately implements in-process rollback.
